name: [W4🎃] +1 Soldier Evolution
desc:
🪖 Become the strongest Soldier! Train your Power, wipe out the zombie horde, and evolve your soldier as you grow stronger!

🖱️ Click to gain +1 Power!
💥 More Power = More Damage!
🔫 Unlock and upgrade powerful Guns!
🧟 Clear enemies to unlock new stages!
🪖 Evolve your soldier and climb the ranks!
👑 Beat Minibosses and World Bosses for loot!
🥚 Hatch pets and 🔄 Rebirth to get even stronger!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support future updates!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
